  T1.recordregistry AS record_id, 
  T1.gdprcomp AS gdpr_compliance_status, 
  T1.loclawcomp AS local_law_compliance_status,

  Compliance AS T1

  OR T1.loclawcomp != 'Compliant' 
ORDER BY 
  record_id;

SELECT 
  T1.recordregistry AS record_id, 
  T1.gdprcomp AS gdpr_compliance_status, 
  T1.loclawcomp AS local_law_compliance_status, 
  T2.destnation AS transfer_path 
FROM 
  Compliance AS T1 
  JOIN DataFlow AS T2 ON T1.recordregistry = T2.recordregistry 
WHERE 
  T1.gdprcomp != 'Compliant' 
  OR T1.loclawcomp != 'Compliant' 
ORDER BY 
  record_id;
